比较澳大利亚 15 个固定城市样本在 SSP1-2.6 与 SSP5-8.5 下的未来最高气温，模型为 ACCESS-CM2，分辨率为 5 arc-minutes，时期为 2081–2100。差值统一为 **SSP585 − SSP126**。

`tmax` 是每日最高气温的月平均气候值；十二层对应十二个日历月，不是二十年的逐年值或绝对最高温纪录。两条路径分别为 SSP1 / SSP5 家族内的具体情景。两情景固定模型、时期、网格、城市集合和取样格号。

## 结果摘要

180 个城市×月份配对均完整。SSP585−SSP126 的城市月份等权平均差为 3.31 °C；城市平均差从 Bunbury 的 2.78 °C 到 Orange 的 3.88 °C。三个海岸邻格均在 15 km 内；结果是单一模型、有限城市的情景比较。

## 输入文件

国界复用 GADM 4.1 Australia；未来气温采用 WorldClim CMIP6 的 ACCESS-CM2、5 分、2081–2100 `tmax`。课堂历史 `tavg` 不替代未来最高气温。

```{r week03-hw-inputs}
gadm_file <- file.path(root, "data/raw/week03/gadm41_AUS.gpkg")
raw_dir <- file.path(root, "data/raw/week03/homework/ACCESS-CM2-5m-tmax-2081-2100")
dir.create(raw_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
tmax126_file <- file.path(raw_dir, "wc2.1_5m_tmax_ACCESS-CM2_ssp126_2081-2100.tif")
tmax585_file <- file.path(raw_dir, "wc2.1_5m_tmax_ACCESS-CM2_ssp585_2081-2100.tif")
```

### 下载

```{r week03-hw-download, eval=FALSE}
options(timeout = 1200)
download.file("https://geodata.ucdavis.edu/gadm/gadm4.1/gpkg/gadm41_AUS.gpkg", gadm_file, mode = "wb")
download.file("https://geodata.ucdavis.edu/cmip6/5m/ACCESS-CM2/ssp126/wc2.1_5m_tmax_ACCESS-CM2_ssp126_2081-2100.tif", tmax126_file, mode = "wb")
download.file("https://geodata.ucdavis.edu/cmip6/5m/ACCESS-CM2/ssp585/wc2.1_5m_tmax_ACCESS-CM2_ssp585_2081-2100.tif", tmax585_file, mode = "wb")
```

```{r week03-hw-check-input-files}
stopifnot(all(file.exists(c(gadm_file, tmax126_file, tmax585_file))))
```

## 国界与坐标参考系

国家层为 ADM_0；EPSG:3112 用于澳大利亚显示。坐标转换使用 `st_transform()`，不以改写 CRS 标签代替转换。离岸岛屿保留在分析范围内。

```{r week03-hw-country-crs}
country_layers <- sf::st_layers(gadm_file)
print(country_layers)
country_layer <- country_layers$name[grepl("_0$", country_layers$name)]
if (length(country_layer) != 1L) stop("GADM 国家层不唯一。")
aus <- sf::st_read(gadm_file, layer = country_layer, quiet = TRUE)
print(sf::st_crs(aus))
if (is.na(sf::st_crs(aus))) stop("边界缺少 CRS。")
aus_3112 <- sf::st_transform(aus, 3112)
print(sf::st_crs(aus_3112))
```

## 月份、网格与温度单位

核对十二层 `tmax01`–`tmax12`、5/60 度分辨率、CRS 和共同网格后，月份命名为 Jan–Dec。本次 CMIP6 浮点 TIFF 已为 °C，不套用旧版 `°C×10` 规则，不再除以 10。

```{r week03-hw-read-rasters}
tmax126 <- terra::rast(tmax126_file)
tmax585 <- terra::rast(tmax585_file)
print(tmax126)
print(tmax585)
print(names(tmax126))
print(names(tmax585))
expected_bands <- sprintf("tmax%02d", 1:12)
stopifnot(terra::nlyr(tmax126) == 12L, terra::nlyr(tmax585) == 12L)
stopifnot(identical(names(tmax126), expected_bands), identical(names(tmax585), expected_bands))
stopifnot(all(abs(terra::res(tmax126) - 5 / 60) < 1e-6))
stopifnot(nzchar(terra::crs(tmax126)), nzchar(terra::crs(tmax585)))
stopifnot(terra::compareGeom(tmax126, tmax585, lyrs = TRUE, res = TRUE, stopOnError = FALSE))
print(terra::scoff(tmax126))
print(terra::scoff(tmax585))
names(tmax126) <- month.abb # CMIP6 浮点数据已为 °C，不再除以 10
names(tmax585) <- month.abb
```

## 城市参考点

课堂坐标中 Broome 使用南纬 -17.96；Melbourne 改用 [BOM Olympic Park](https://www.bom.gov.au/climate/averages/tables/cw_086338.shtml) 的 `(144.98, -37.83)`。原坐标保存在 `source_lon` / `source_lat`，温度来自 WorldClim。

```{r week03-hw-cities}
cities <- tibble::tibble(
  Site = c("Brisbane", "Melbourne", "Perth", "Sydney", "Broome", "Darwin", "Orange", "Bunbury", "Cairns", "Adelaide", "Gold Coast", "Canberra", "Newcastle", "Wollongong", "Logan City"),
  lon = c(153.03, 144.96, 115.86, 151.21, 122.23, 130.84, 149.10, 115.64, 145.77, 138.60, 153.43, 149.13, 151.78, 150.89, 153.12),
  lat = c(-27.47, -37.91, -31.95, -33.87, -17.96, -12.46, -33.28, -33.33, -16.92, -34.93, -28.00, -35.28, -32.93, -34.42, -27.64)
 ) %>% dplyr::mutate(city_id = dplyr::row_number())
cities <- cities %>% dplyr::mutate(
  source_lon = lon, source_lat = lat,
  lon = dplyr::if_else(Site == "Melbourne", 144.98, lon),
  lat = dplyr::if_else(Site == "Melbourne", -37.83, lat),
  coordinate_source = dplyr::if_else(Site == "Melbourne", "BOM Melbourne Olympic Park 086338", "Course sample; Broome latitude sign corrected")
)
stopifnot(!anyNA(cities$Site), !anyDuplicated(cities$Site))
stopifnot(!anyNA(cities$city_id), !anyDuplicated(cities$city_id))
stopifnot(nrow(cities) == 15L, all(cities$lat < 0), all(cities$lon > 0))
city_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(cities, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
city_for_raster <- sf::st_transform(city_sf, crs = terra::crs(tmax126))
city_vector <- terra::vect(city_for_raster)
print(city_sf)
```

## 原格提取与海岸缺失

先保留两个情景的原格提取与月份缺失记录，不把缺失转换为零或直接删去城市。

```{r week03-hw-extract-original}
raw_extract126 <- terra::extract(tmax126, city_vector, method = "simple")
raw_extract585 <- terra::extract(tmax585, city_vector, method = "simple")
original_missing <- tibble::tibble(
  city_id = cities$city_id, Site = cities$Site,
  missing126 = rowSums(!is.finite(as.matrix(raw_extract126[month.abb]))),
  missing585 = rowSums(!is.finite(as.matrix(raw_extract585[month.abb])))
)
print(original_missing, n = Inf)
```

### 共同有效邻格规则

原格二情景共 24 个值完整时保留原格；否则仅检查原格和八邻格，在中心位于澳大利亚、二情景全年完整且距参考点不超过 **15 km** 的候选中选择最近格，相同距离按格号固定排序。无合格候选则停止，不自动扩大范围。

两个情景共用格号，取样位置与距离保存在 `sampling_audit`。邻格温度是城市附近格网的近似值。

```{r week03-hw-coastal-sampling}
stopifnot(terra::compareGeom(tmax126, tmax585, lyrs = TRUE, res = TRUE, stopOnError = FALSE))
original_cells <- terra::cellFromXY(tmax126, terra::crds(city_vector))
stopifnot(!anyNA(original_cells))
selected_cells <- original_cells
needs_neighbour <- original_missing$missing126 > 0L | original_missing$missing585 > 0L
max_distance_m <- 15000 # 缺失点只检查 3×3 邻格，二情景共用取样格
land_for_sampling <- sf::st_transform(aus, crs = terra::crs(tmax126))
for (i in which(needs_neighbour)) {
  centre_rc <- terra::rowColFromCell(tmax126, original_cells[i])
  candidate_rc <- expand.grid(row = centre_rc[1, 1] + (-1:1), col = centre_rc[1, 2] + (-1:1))
  candidate_rc <- candidate_rc[candidate_rc$row >= 1 & candidate_rc$row <= nrow(tmax126) & candidate_rc$col >= 1 & candidate_rc$col <= ncol(tmax126), ]
  candidate_cells <- terra::cellFromRowCol(tmax126, candidate_rc$row, candidate_rc$col)
  candidate126 <- terra::extract(tmax126, candidate_cells)
  candidate585 <- terra::extract(tmax585, candidate_cells)
  common_complete <- rowSums(!is.finite(as.matrix(candidate126))) == 0L & rowSums(!is.finite(as.matrix(candidate585))) == 0L
  candidate_xy <- terra::xyFromCell(tmax126, candidate_cells)
  candidate_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(as.data.frame(candidate_xy), coords = c("x", "y"), crs = terra::crs(tmax126))
  on_land <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(candidate_sf, land_for_sampling)) > 0L
  distance_m <- as.numeric(sf::st_distance(city_for_raster[i, ], candidate_sf))
  acceptable <- common_complete & on_land & is.finite(distance_m) & distance_m <= max_distance_m
  if (!any(acceptable)) stop("15 km 内没有共同有效陆地邻格：", cities$Site[i])
  ranked <- which(acceptable)[order(distance_m[acceptable], candidate_cells[acceptable])]
  selected_cells[i] <- candidate_cells[ranked[1]]
}
selected_xy <- terra::xyFromCell(tmax126, selected_cells)
selected_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(as.data.frame(selected_xy), coords = c("x", "y"), crs = terra::crs(tmax126))
sampling_audit <- cities %>% dplyr::select(city_id, Site, source_lon, source_lat, lon, lat, coordinate_source) %>% dplyr::mutate(
  original_cell = original_cells, selected_cell = selected_cells,
  sample_lon = selected_xy[, 1], sample_lat = selected_xy[, 2],
  neighbour_used = selected_cells != original_cells,
  point_to_sample_m = as.numeric(sf::st_distance(city_for_raster, selected_sf, by_element = TRUE))
)
print(sampling_audit, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

### 共同格提取

从同一格号提取两个情景十二个月，按明确城市 ID 一对一连接。后续保持十五城市完整性检查。

```{r week03-hw-extract}
extract126 <- tibble::as_tibble(terra::extract(tmax126, selected_cells)) %>% dplyr::mutate(ID = cities$city_id, .before = 1)
extract585 <- tibble::as_tibble(terra::extract(tmax585, selected_cells)) %>% dplyr::mutate(ID = cities$city_id, .before = 1)
stopifnot(!anyNA(extract126$ID), !anyDuplicated(extract126$ID))
stopifnot(!anyNA(extract585$ID), !anyDuplicated(extract585$ID))
stopifnot(setequal(cities$city_id, extract126$ID), setequal(cities$city_id, extract585$ID))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(as.matrix(extract126[month.abb]))), all(is.finite(as.matrix(extract585[month.abb]))))
city126 <- dplyr::left_join(cities, extract126, by = c("city_id" = "ID"), relationship = "one-to-one")
city585 <- dplyr::left_join(cities, extract585, by = c("city_id" = "ID"), relationship = "one-to-one")
print(city126, width = Inf)
print(city585, width = Inf)
```

## 城市—月份—情景长表

长表包含 15×12×2 行，按城市、月份和情景检查唯一性与缺失。

```{r week03-hw-long-table}
long126 <- city126 %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(month.abb), names_to = "Month", values_to = "tmax_c") %>% dplyr::mutate(Scenario = "SSP126")
long585 <- city585 %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(month.abb), names_to = "Month", values_to = "tmax_c") %>% dplyr::mutate(Scenario = "SSP585")
city_month <- dplyr::bind_rows(long126, long585) %>% dplyr::mutate(month_no = match(Month, month.abb))
stopifnot(nrow(city_month) == 15L * 12L * 2L)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(city_month[c("Site", "month_no", "Scenario")]))
missing_check <- city_month %>% dplyr::group_by(Site, Scenario) %>% dplyr::summarise(months = dplyr::n(), missing = sum(is.na(tmax_c)), .groups = "drop")
print(missing_check, n = Inf)
if (anyNA(city_month$tmax_c)) stop("城市月份含缺失值。")
if (any(!is.finite(city_month$tmax_c)) || any(city_month$tmax_c < -80 | city_month$tmax_c > 70)) stop("温度不在预期范围内。")
```

### 配对差值

城市与月份双键匹配，双向检查漏接后计算 `delta_c`。差值是两个未来情景之差，不是相对历史或当前气温的升温。

```{r week03-hw-pair-differences}
low <- city_month %>% dplyr::filter(Scenario == "SSP126") %>% dplyr::select(Site, month_no, Month, tmax126_c = tmax_c)
high <- city_month %>% dplyr::filter(Scenario == "SSP585") %>% dplyr::select(Site, month_no, tmax585_c = tmax_c)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(low[c("Site", "month_no")]), !anyDuplicated(high[c("Site", "month_no")]))
stopifnot(nrow(dplyr::anti_join(low, high, by = c("Site", "month_no"))) == 0L)
stopifnot(nrow(dplyr::anti_join(high, low, by = c("Site", "month_no"))) == 0L)
paired <- dplyr::left_join(low, high, by = c("Site", "month_no"), relationship = "one-to-one") %>% dplyr::mutate(delta_c = tmax585_c - tmax126_c)
paired <- paired %>% dplyr::arrange(Site, month_no)
stopifnot(nrow(paired) == 180L, !anyNA(paired[c("tmax126_c", "tmax585_c", "delta_c")]))
print(paired, n = 24, width = Inf)
```

## 描述统计

每城、每情景计算十二月均值、中位数、样本标准差、四分位数、IQR 和范围。月份等权，不按天数加权；跨月 SD 描述季节离散，不代表逐年变动、模型误差或不确定性区间。四分位数采用 R type 7。

```{r week03-hw-scenario-statistics}
city_stats <- city_month %>% dplyr::group_by(Site, Scenario) %>% dplyr::summarise(
  n_months = dplyr::n(),
  mean_c = mean(tmax_c),
  median_c = median(tmax_c),
  sd_c = sd(tmax_c),
  q1_c = unname(quantile(tmax_c, probs = 0.25, type = 7)),
  q3_c = unname(quantile(tmax_c, probs = 0.75, type = 7)),
  iqr_c = IQR(tmax_c, type = 7),
  min_c = min(tmax_c),
  max_c = max(tmax_c),
  .groups = "drop"
)
print(city_stats, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

### 每城十二月情景差

```{r week03-hw-difference-statistics}
delta_stats <- paired %>% dplyr::group_by(Site) %>% dplyr::summarise(
  n_pairs = dplyr::n(),
  mean_delta_c = mean(delta_c),
  median_delta_c = median(delta_c),
  sd_delta_c = sd(delta_c),
  q1_delta_c = unname(quantile(delta_c, 0.25, type = 7)),
  q3_delta_c = unname(quantile(delta_c, 0.75, type = 7)),
  iqr_delta_c = IQR(delta_c, type = 7),
  min_delta_c = min(delta_c),
  max_delta_c = max(delta_c),
  .groups = "drop"
) %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_delta_c))
print(delta_stats, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

### 统计量对照

完整等权配对下，均值之差等于差值均值；中位数之差与差值中位数是不同指标。

```{r week03-hw-statistic-comparison}
comparison <- city_stats %>% dplyr::select(Site, Scenario, mean_c, median_c, sd_c, q1_c, q3_c) %>% tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Scenario, values_from = c(mean_c, median_c, sd_c, q1_c, q3_c))
comparison <- comparison %>% dplyr::mutate(mean_difference_c = mean_c_SSP585 - mean_c_SSP126, median_difference_c = median_c_SSP585 - median_c_SSP126)
comparison <- dplyr::left_join(comparison, delta_stats, by = "Site", relationship = "one-to-one")
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(comparison$mean_difference_c, comparison$mean_delta_c, tolerance = 1e-8)))
print(comparison, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

### 每月城市样本统计

城市等权样本不代表全国人口或面积加权气温；十二个气候月份也不作为独立随机天气观测。

```{r week03-hw-monthly-statistics}
month_stats <- paired %>% dplyr::group_by(month_no, Month) %>% dplyr::summarise(
  n_cities = dplyr::n(),
  mean_delta_c = mean(delta_c),
  median_delta_c = median(delta_c),
  sd_delta_c = sd(delta_c),
  q1_delta_c = unname(quantile(delta_c, 0.25, type = 7)),
  q3_delta_c = unname(quantile(delta_c, 0.75, type = 7)),
  .groups = "drop"
) %>% dplyr::arrange(month_no)
print(month_stats, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

## 国家栅格与情景差

先按矩形 crop，再以原始国界 mask。分析边界不简化；两情景网格一致后逐格相减，再对十二个月等权平均，未计算全国面积加权均值。

```{r week03-hw-crop-mask}
aus_for_raster <- sf::st_transform(aus, crs = terra::crs(tmax126))
aus_vector <- terra::vect(aus_for_raster)
crop126 <- terra::crop(tmax126, aus_vector)
crop585 <- terra::crop(tmax585, aus_vector)
mask126 <- terra::mask(crop126, aus_vector)
mask585 <- terra::mask(crop585, aus_vector)
stopifnot(terra::compareGeom(mask126, mask585, lyrs = TRUE, res = TRUE, stopOnError = FALSE))
delta_raster <- mask585 - mask126
names(delta_raster) <- month.abb
mean_delta_raster <- terra::app(delta_raster, fun = mean, na.rm = FALSE)
names(mean_delta_raster) <- "mean_delta_c"
print(mean_delta_raster)
```

## 图表

月曲线保留绝对温度与情景对应；箱线图按城市显示十二月差值，直方图统计城市—月份对。图形描述样本与季节差异，不作为未来发生概率分布。

### 月曲线

```{r week03-hw-seasonal-plot, fig.height=10}
seasonal_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(city_month, ggplot2::aes(x = month_no, y = tmax_c, colour = Scenario, group = Scenario)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ Site, ncol = 3) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 4, 7, 10, 12), labels = month.abb[c(1, 4, 7, 10, 12)]) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c(SSP126 = "#2166AC", SSP585 = "#B2182B")) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Monthly maximum temperature at 15 Australian sample locations", subtitle = "ACCESS-CM2, 2081–2100, 5 arc-minutes", x = "Month", y = "Monthly mean maximum temperature (°C)", colour = "Scenario") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
print(seasonal_plot)
```

### 城市差值箱线图

```{r week03-hw-difference-boxplot, fig.height=7}
box_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(paired, ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(Site, delta_c, FUN = median), y = delta_c)) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(fill = "#ABD9E9", outlier.shape = NA) +
  ggplot2::geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 1.1, alpha = 0.65) +
  ggplot2::coord_flip() +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Monthly scenario differences by city", subtitle = "Each city has 12 paired climatological months; ACCESS-CM2, 2081–2100", x = NULL, y = "SSP585 − SSP126 (°C)") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
print(box_plot)
```

### 城市—月份差值分布

```{r week03-hw-difference-histogram}
hist_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(paired, ggplot2::aes(x = delta_c)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "#FDAE61", colour = "white") +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +

  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
print(hist_plot)
```

### 国家差值与城市点

栅格和城市点使用共同色标范围；国界仅为显示按 1000 米容差简化。地图显示投影不改变提取使用的原始网格。

```{r week03-hw-map, fig.height=8}
city_result_sf <- dplyr::left_join(city_sf, delta_stats, by = "Site", relationship = "one-to-one")
city_result_3112 <- sf::st_transform(city_result_sf, 3112)
aus_display <- sf::st_simplify(aus_3112, dTolerance = 1000, preserveTopology = TRUE)
map_min <- terra::global(mean_delta_raster, fun = "min", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
map_max <- terra::global(mean_delta_raster, fun = "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
map_limits <- range(c(map_min, map_max, city_result_3112$mean_delta_c))
tmap::tmap_mode("plot")
result_map <- tmap::tm_shape(mean_delta_raster, crs = 3112) +
  tmap::tm_raster(col = "mean_delta_c", col.scale = tmap::tm_scale_continuous(values = "brewer.yl_or_rd", limits = map_limits), col.legend = tmap::tm_legend(title = "Grid: mean ΔT (°C)")) +
  tmap::tm_shape(aus_display) +
  tmap::tm_borders(col = "grey30", lwd = 0.6) +
  tmap::tm_shape(city_result_3112) +
  tmap::tm_dots(fill = "mean_delta_c", fill.scale = tmap::tm_scale_continuous(values = "brewer.yl_or_rd", limits = map_limits), fill.legend = tmap::tm_legend(title = "Cities: mean ΔT (°C)"), size = 0.35) +
  tmap::tm_title("SSP585 − SSP126: ACCESS-CM2, 2081–2100") +
  tmap::tm_layout(frame = FALSE)
print(result_map)
```

## 可选导出

表格和图片保存到带运行时间的 `week03/outputs/` 子目录。

```{r week03-hw-export, eval=FALSE}
stamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
output_dir <- file.path(root, "week03/outputs", paste0("homework-access-cm2-", stamp))
if (dir.exists(output_dir)) stop("已有同名运行目录，请等一秒后重新运行或改名。")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(cities, file.path(output_dir, "city-coordinate-source-sample.csv"))
readr::write_csv(sampling_audit, file.path(output_dir, "coastal-sampling-audit.csv"))
readr::write_csv(paired, file.path(output_dir, "paired-city-month-temperatures.csv"))

readr::write_csv(delta_stats, file.path(output_dir, "city-difference-descriptive-statistics.csv"))

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "city-difference-boxplot.png"), plot = box_plot, device = ragg::agg_png, width = 9, height = 7, units = "in", dpi = 150)
```
